Let my thoughts, choices, and reactions show that let integrity matter more to me than applause. Shape my heart until it reflects the heart of Christ. Give me grace for this moment and courage for the next. Amen.

Lord Jesus, my mind is crowded with worries I cannot solve alone. Quiet the noise within me and remind me that your presence is stronger than panic. Teach my heart to breathe in your peace. Shape my heart until it reflects the heart of Christ. Help me walk in faith today, one step at a time. Amen.
